candidates.explanation: The branch `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }` treats an omitted photo field as an explicit request to clear it. When the profile edit only sends firstName, photo is undefined, so photo is set to null. UserMapper.toPersistence then maps null to a null photo, and the save clears the photo relation. The create method correctly uses `=== null`. Only an explicit `photo: null` should clear the photo. An omitted field should stay undefined so the existing photo is left unchanged.

fix.description: Change the condition to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null)` so only an explicit null clears the photo, and an omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged.

candidates.explanation: The branch `else if (updateUserDto.photo === undefined) { photo = null; }` treats an omitted photo field as an explicit request to clear it. When the profile edit only sends firstName, photo is undefined, so photo is set to null. UserMapper.toPersistence then maps null to a null photo, and the save clears the photo relation. The create method correctly uses `=== null`. Only an explicit `photo: null` should clear the photo. An omitted field should stay undefined so the existing photo is left unchanged.

fix.description: Change the condition to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null)` so only an explicit null clears the photo, and an omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged.
